{{Top}}
'''Shipjackers''' were [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] who specialized in the theft of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]] contracted shipjackers to steal vessels such as [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] and [[Super Transport series|Super Transports]].

[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], [[Cryle Cavv]], and [[Sienn Sconn]] were considered to be among the best shipjackers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
